summary.en: Iran-backed suspects are accused of planning attacks on a U.K. air base that hosts U.S. jets in Iraq, while an Iran-backed trio is linked to a drone strike that disabled the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan. Iraqi security officials have expanded air-defence deployments, created a special security force and an energy police unit to protect pipelines and curb oil smuggling, and are sending a delegation to Lebanon to assist the inquiry into former MP Ahmed al-Alwani’s death. The conflict remains low-level but sees coordinated Iranian proxy actions against both military and energy targets, and a new diplomatic outreach to Lebanon. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iran-støttede mistenkte er anklaget for å ha planlagt angrep på en britisk flybase som huser amerikanske jetfly i Irak, mens en Iran-støttet trio er knyttet til et droneangrep som gjorde Khor Mor-gassfeltet i irakisk Kurdistan ute av drift. Iraks sikkerhetsmyndigheter har utvidet luftforsvarsutplasseringer, opprettet en spesiell sikkerhetsstyrke og en energipoliti for å beskytte rørledninger og dempe oljesmugling, og sender en delegasjon til Libanon for å bistå etterforskningen av tidligere stortingsrepresentant Ahmed al-Alwanis død. Konflikten forblir på lavt nivå, men viser koordinerte iranske stedfortrederhandlinger mot både militære og energimål, samt en ny diplomatisk kontakt med Libanon. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
